restaurantName: La Table du Coly - Manoir d'Hautegente
bio: The fine dining restaurant is perfectly in keeping with the rest of the manor. In the lovely dining area with its exposed stone walls and imposing fireplace, diners enjoy sophisticated, imaginative cuisine. On sunny days, make a beeline for the pergola by the mill stream!
